Method.Implementation: Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetEnvironmentId") &sql(Select ID INTO :envId from Environment where Environment = :env) IF (SQLCODE '= 0) { set fault=..MakeFault($$$FAULTServer, "SQL error", "Could not get Env Id for " _ env _ " from .Environment") Do ..ReturnFault(fault) QUIT } Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("EnvironmentId: " _ envId) return envId

Method.name: GetLastImplementationDetails
Method.Implementation:
set implFile = "%_CLS_" _ compName _"%"
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetLastImplementationDetails get class implementation") Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile(compName _", " _ implFile _", " _ env _ ", " _ nmSp)
&sql(select count(*) into :numImpl from Component c, ComponentImpl ci, Environment e, Namespaces n where ci.ComponentName = c.ID and ci.Environment = e.ID and n.ID = c.NameSpace and c.ComponentName = :compName AND e.Environment = :env and n.Namespace = :nmSp) IF ( (SQLCODE '= 0) || (numImpl <= 0)) { set fault=..MakeFault($$$FAULTServer, " SrcCtrlDeploymentInfoWebService: SQL returned 0 rows - ", compName _ " in not deployed in " _ env _ ", SQLCODE: " _SQLCODE _ ";") Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("SQL returned 0 rows for " _ compName _ ", SQLCODE: " _SQLCODE) Do ..ReturnFault(fault) QUIT } &sql(select ImplFile, ImplFileVersion, ImplementionDate INTO :filenm, :implVersion, :implDt from ComponentImpl where ImplementionDate = (select MAX(ImplementionDate) from Component c, ComponentImpl ci, Environment e, Namespaces n where ci.ComponentName = c.ID and ci.Environment = e.ID and n.ID = c.NameSpace and c.ComponentName = :compName and ci.ImplFile like :implFile AND e.Environment = :env and n.Namespace = :nmSp)) IF (SQLCODE '= 0) { // No classes, find CONFIG Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetLastImplementationDetails get config implementation")
set implFile = "%_CONFIG_" _ compName _"%" &sql(select ImplFile, ImplFileVersion, ImplementionDate INTO :filenm, :implVersion, :implDt from ComponentImpl where ImplementionDate = (select MAX(ImplementionDate) from Component c, ComponentImpl ci, Environment e, Namespaces n where ci.ComponentName = c.ID and ci.Environment = e.ID and n.ID = c.NameSpace and c.ComponentName = :compName and ci.ImplFile like :implFile AND e.Environment = :env and n.Namespace = :nmSp)) IF (SQLCODE '= 0) { set fault=..MakeFault($$$FAULTServer, "SQL error", "Could not get ImplementionDate for " _ compName _ " from .ComponentImpl") Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("SQLCODE: " _ SQLCODE) Do ..ReturnFault(fault) QUIT } } Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile(filenm _ " Impl Version " _ implVersion) return filenm _ ";" _ implVersion _ ";" _ implDt

Method.name: GetClassesForComponent
Method.Implementation:
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetClassesForComponent for " _ compNm _ ", rev: " _ rev) set clsList = ##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New() NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "DEPLOYHIST"
set compId = ..GetComponentId(compNm, nmSp)
&sql(Declare C1 Cursor for SELECT distinct ci.ClassName into :clsNm from IHC_ITF_SrcCtrlPkg.ComponentImpl i, IHC_ITF_SrcCtrlPkg.ClassItem ci where i.ImplFile = ci.ClassExportFile and ci.componentName = :compId and i.ImplFileVersion = :rev and ci.importDate = i.ImplementionDate)
Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN C1) While (SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH C1) if SQLCODE = 0 { Do clsList.Insert(clsNm) } }
&sql(CLOSE C1) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("ClassesForComponent: " _ clsList.Count()) Quit clsList

Method.name: GetClassInformation
Method.Implementation:
NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "DEPLOYHIST" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetClassInformation for " _ clsName _ " in " _ env _ ", rev# " _ revNum)
set clsList = ##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New()
set envId = ..GetEnvironmentId(env)
&sql(Declare C2 Cursor for select ClassName, ClassExportFile, ClassExportFileVersion INTO :clsNm, :clsfile, :version from ClassItem where ClassName = :clsName and Environment = :envId and ClassExportFileVersion = :revNum) Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN C2) While (SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH C2)
if (SQLCODE = 0) { Do clsList.Insert(clsNm _ "," _ clsfile _ "," _ version) QUIT } } &sql(CLOSE C2) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetClassInformation: " _ clsList.Count()) Quit clsList

Method.name: UpdateComponentImpl
UpdateClassItem
Method.Implementation:
NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "DEPLOYHIST" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("In UpdateClassItem for " _ clNm _ ", component: " _ componentNm _ " in " _ nmSp _ " Environment: " _ env)
set compId = ..GetComponentId(componentNm, nmSp)
set envId = ..GetEnvironmentId(env)
&sql(INSERT INTO ClassItem (ClassName, ComponentName, Environment, ClassExportFile, ClassExportFileVersion, ClassExportFileInformation, ImportDate, UserName ) values (:clNm, :compId, :envId, :DeploymentFile, :fileVersion, :fileInfo, :dt, :usrNm ) ) if SQLCODE = 0 { Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Insert Done") return $$$OK } else { set fault=..MakeFault($$$FAULTServer, "SQL error", "Insert to ComponentImpl failed " _ $SYSTEM.SQL.SQLCODE(SQLCODE)) Do ..ReturnFault(fault) QUIT
}
